# Akash Gogate

> CS + Biology student at UW-Madison (graduating May 2028). Building at the intersection of distributed systems and biological data science.

Currently building LLM agent pipelines for spatial transcriptomics research at the Kendziorski Lab. Industry experience in backend infrastructure and distributed systems at Leidos.

This is the design-forward build of the portfolio — animated interactions, scroll-driven reveals, and a DNA-inspired hero visual. A plainer, no-animation build of the same content lives at https://personalportfoliowebsite.akashgogate.com.

## Site sections

- Hero: DNA-inspired animated intro
- About: background, interests, current focus
- Experience: work history (Leidos, Kendziorski Lab, and others)
- Accomplishments: awards and recognitions
- Projects: portfolio of software projects
- Skills: technical skills, proficiency 4-5
- Education: coursework at UW-Madison
- Contact: email, GitHub, LinkedIn
